metaDescription: Collect and clean scattered data, then automate metrics and reports. Newon DATA & REPORTING.
headline:
Gather scattered data
and turn it into what you need.
lead: We collect and organize data spread across services and documents, then automate the metrics and reports you need — from recurring collection and cleanup to calculation, visualization, report generation, and delivery.

meta.v: Recurring data collection and reporting work

overviewTitle:
Spend less time gathering data,
more time using it.
overviewBody: Teams constantly create data across many services.
When sales, inquiries, marketing, product usage, projects, surveys, reviews, and ops data live in different places, people end up hunting, copying, and cleaning by hand.
DATA & REPORTING connects that repetitive work into one data flow — pull what you need, clean by rules, calculate key metrics, and deliver as a Dashboard or Report.

problems.d: People still pull data from multiple services by hand.
Formats differ and cleanup happens every time.
Weekly or monthly reports are rebuilt repeatedly.
Sales, users, inquiries, and conversion need ongoing tracking.
Data is scattered across spreadsheets, forms, and databases.
Finished reports must reach owners on a schedule.

baTitle:
Manual reporting vs
automated DATA & REPORTING
after: Deliver reports and dashboards on schedule
capsTitle: We build the data flow you need.

caps.d: Pull required data from multiple sources.
Clean duplicates, empty values, and format gaps by defined rules.
Transform raw data into shapes ready for analysis and reporting.
Calculate metrics like revenue, growth, conversion, and users.
Generate reports on weekly, monthly, or other cadences.
Build a dashboard that keeps key metrics visible in one place.
When needed, summarize data or customer feedback with AI.
Deliver results to email, spreadsheets, dashboards, or other destinations.

sourcesTitle: Connect the data you already use.
sourcesNote: Actual connectivity depends on each service’s API and data-access method.

Organize ads and marketing data to compare channel performance.

Collect product reviews and summarize themes, issues, and rating trends.
Organize user and product data into core product metrics.

aiNote: AI analysis and summaries are for reference. Important decisions may still require checking the source data.
delTitle: What you receive after the project

faqs.a: Spreadsheets, CSV, databases, analytics, forms, and external APIs are common. Actual connectivity depends on each service’s access method and API.

faqs.q: Can we start with Google Sheets only?
faqs.a: Yes. We review the current structure, then define cleanup and automation scope.

faqs.q: Can we receive reports every week automatically?
faqs.a: Depending on scope, we can build scheduled processing and delivery.

faqs.q: Can you build a dashboard too?
faqs.a: Yes. Metrics, refresh method, and user context are scoped separately when needed.
Yes — for example classifying and summarizing reviews, inquiries, and survey text.

faqs.q: What if our data is messy?
faqs.a: We start by reviewing current data quality. Heavy cleanup may be scoped as additional work.
It depends on the source and API. Real-time processing is not guaranteed for every system.

faqs.q: Do you support maintenance after launch?
faqs.a: Yes — source changes, automation edits, and feature additions can be scoped separately.
